Generate commit messages following Conventional Commits.

Rules:
- Use one of: feat, fix, refactor, perf, test, docs, chore, ci, build.
- Always include a scope when possible.
- Write the description in English.
- Use imperative mood.
- Be concise (max 72 characters).
- Mention the user-visible or architectural change, not implementation details.
- Never use emojis.
- Never end the summary with a period.
